{{Top|leg}}
'''Jawa ale''' was a type of [[Ale/Legends|ale]] that was sold in bottles. The ale was available on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]; the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Kardue'sai'Malloc/Legends|Kardue'sai'Malloc]] was often found to be carrying a half-empty bottle of Jawa ale.<ref name="SWTSE">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref>
